output.summary: An annual thistle-like plant native to Mediterranean Europe and western and Central Asia, it has a sprawling habit and downy, leathery leaves with small marginal spines. Its yellow flower heads are surrounded by numerous spiny bracts and appear from midsummer to early autumn.
output.edibilityNote: Bitter leaves are used to flavour alcoholic drinks; it is considered safe for food use, though large amounts may cause digestive symptoms.
